layouts.name: Calder
layouts.description: Draft northern-return course on the unchanged OSM trace. Image-estimated borders follow the visible paved return; this configuration is not verified as the operator National Circuit. Eastern shared drag/forecourt pavement, access joins and blurred edges remain estimates. No nominal width or length is fitted.

layouts.name: Calder Short
layouts.description: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 1483.7 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 2.7 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.
